scenes.vo: Want more clients from LinkedIn? Here's the five-layer system I'd build.
scenes.visual: A profile card beside an empty five-slot pipeline; the slots fill and a lime line connects them into one system.
scenes.animation: Headline mask reveals, cards tilt in from both sides, connector draws, slots fill in sequence.
scenes.sound: Score starts on frame one; soft whoosh as the cards arrive.

scenes.vo: First, optimize your profile. Use your buyers' keywords, explain the outcome you deliver, and add one clear call to action.

data.after: Helping D2C Brands Improve Customer Retention with Lifecycle Marketing
about: Repeat purchases stall after the first order.
Lifecycle email, SMS and loyalty flows.

scenes.visual: Illustrative profile: the headline is deleted and retyped live (before and after), keywords light up, the banner and About section fill in, and a CTA button appears.
scenes.animation: Card tilts in; the focus camera follows the cursor from headline to About to CTA; typing and clicks.
scenes.sound: Clicks on the edit and on the CTA.

scenes.vo: Next, define your ideal customer and use Sales Navigator or Apollo to build a focused prospect list. Let AI help prioritize the best fits.
scenes.visual: Lead search: ICP filter chips fill in, five illustrative leads populate with fit scores and signals, then an AI prioritize click re-sorts them and tags priority.
scenes.animation: Camera starts on the filters, moves to the list, and pushes in as rows re-sort.
scenes.sound: Clicks on filters and on AI prioritize.

scenes.vo: Use AI to turn relevant research into personalized messages. Review each one before it goes out.
scenes.sourceLabel: Connection notes: 200 characters max · LinkedIn Help

research: Company news: expanding its D2C range
data.generic: Hi, I'd love to connect and explore synergies.
data.personalized: Hi Sarah, noticed your team is expanding its D2C range. I work on retention systems for growing brands and thought it would be useful to connect.

scenes.visual: Prospect record: one genuine business detail is picked, the generic note is struck out, AI types a contextual draft with a character counter, and a human approves it.
scenes.animation: Camera moves down the record as each step happens; the cursor picks, edits and approves.
scenes.sound: Clicks on the pick and the approve.

scenes.vo: Connect your CRM to an automation workflow. Track replies, schedule follow-up tasks, and stop when someone responds.
scenes.sourceLabel: Outreach stays manual · LinkedIn User Agreement 8.2
scenes.visual: A workflow builder wires itself: trigger, task, a manual human step, a reply check that branches to follow-up or stop. A CRM record updates underneath.
scenes.animation: Nodes pop in and edges draw on the spoken words; a lime pulse travels the chain; the camera follows each branch.
scenes.sound: Soft ticks as nodes connect, a switch on stop.

scenes.vo: Finally, qualify interested leads, book calls, and track every outcome in your CRM.

data.reply: Sounds relevant. What does the audit involve?
data.answer: Here's my booking link. Pick any slot.

scenes.visual: A positive reply arrives; the prospect card moves from Contacted to Interested, a booking link goes out, a slot is picked, the card lands in Booked and the step tracker completes.
scenes.animation: Card travels across the kanban with a slight tilt; booking popover; checks fill along the tracker.
scenes.sound: A soft ding when the meeting is booked.
